entries.name: Button
entries.purpose: Triggers an action or submits a form.
useWhen: The person changes something, sends data or moves to the next step.
One primary action per screen region.
avoidWhen: Plain navigation between pages: use a link.
More than one primary button in the same region.
entries.responsive: Height of at least 44 px on touch screens; full width inside narrow forms and stacked action groups.
entries.motion: Background and shadow transition in 150 ms; pressed state scales to 0.98; the loading spinner replaces the icon without changing the width.
accessibility: Native <button> or <a> with the right role.
Icon-only buttons carry an accessible name.
Loading sets aria-busy and keeps the label readable.

entries.name: Text link
entries.purpose: Moves to another page or to an anchor.
useWhen: Navigation inside running text, lists and footers.
A secondary action next to a primary button.
entries.responsive: Standalone links keep 44 px of touch height through padding.
entries.motion: Underline offset or thickness animates on hover in 150 ms; the arrow of a standalone link moves 2 px.
accessibility: Link text says the destination out of context.
External links announce that they open elsewhere when they do.

entries.name: Card
entries.purpose: Groups one subject in a bounded surface.
useWhen: A list of comparable items (plans, posts, records).
A self-contained block in a dashboard.
avoidWhen: Wrapping every section of a page in a card.
entries.responsive: Fluid width inside a grid with minmax(0, 1fr); padding steps down one level below 640 px.
entries.motion: Interactive cards lift 2 px and strengthen the border on hover in 200 ms; entrance in a staggered reveal with the list.
accessibility: An interactive card exposes one link, with the heading as its name.
Heading level follows the page outline.

entries.name: Badge
entries.purpose: Labels a status, category or count in one or two words.
useWhen: Category of a post or plan.
avoidWhen: Color as the only carrier of meaning.
entries.responsive: Does not wrap; truncates with a title when the column is narrow.
entries.motion: A status change cross-fades the color in 200 ms.
accessibility: Status has text, never color alone.
Contrast of 4.5:1 for the label.

entries.name: Avatar
entries.purpose: Represents a person or an organization.
avoidWhen: Decoration without a real person or entity.
entries.responsive: Sizes follow the density of the region; groups collapse to a count on narrow screens.
entries.motion: Image fades in over the fallback in 150 ms.
accessibility: Alt text with the name, or empty alt when the name is beside it.

entries.name: Tabs
entries.purpose: Switches between views of the same subject without leaving the page.
useWhen: Two to six parallel views of one record or section.
avoidWhen: More views than fit: use a select or a side navigation.
entries.responsive: The list scrolls horizontally with a fade on the edge below 640 px, or becomes a select when there are more than four tabs.
entries.motion: The active indicator slides between tabs with a layout animation in 250 ms; the panel content fades in 150 ms.
accessibility: tablist, tab and tabpanel roles with arrow key navigation.
The selected tab is in the URL when it represents a place.

entries.name: Accordion
entries.purpose: Shows and hides sections of content in place.
useWhen: Secondary details that most people skip.
entries.responsive: Full width; trigger of at least 48 px.
entries.motion: The panel opens with grid-template-rows from 0fr to 1fr in 250 ms and the chevron rotates; no height animation.
accessibility: The trigger is a button inside a heading with aria-expanded.
Content stays reachable with scripting off (details/summary).

entries.name: Dropdown menu
entries.purpose: Offers a short list of actions from one trigger.
useWhen: Secondary actions of a record or of the account.
entries.responsive: Becomes a bottom drawer on touch screens when it has more than five items.
entries.motion: Opens from the trigger with scale 0.96 to 1 and fade in 150 ms; closes in 100 ms.
accessibility: menu and menuitem roles, arrow keys, Escape returns focus to the trigger.

entries.name: Tooltip
entries.purpose: Names an icon-only control or shows a short hint on hover and focus.
avoidWhen: Information the person needs to complete the task.
entries.responsive: Not available on touch: the information also exists as a label or in the next screen.
entries.motion: Appears after 300 ms with a 100 ms fade; no delay when moving between neighbors.
accessibility: Opens on focus as well as hover.
Never the only place for essential content.

entries.name: Dialog
entries.purpose: Interrupts to ask for a decision or a short input.
useWhen: A short form that belongs to the current context.
avoidWhen: Messages that do not need an answer: use a toast.
entries.responsive: Becomes a bottom sheet below 640 px, with the actions fixed at the bottom.
entries.motion: Overlay fades in 150 ms; the surface scales from 0.96 and fades in 200 ms; exits are faster than entrances.
accessibility: Focus trapped inside and returned to the trigger.
Title linked with aria-labelledby.
Escape closes unless the action is in progress.

entries.name: Drawer
entries.purpose: Slides a panel from an edge for secondary content or navigation.
useWhen: Details or filters beside a list.
entries.responsive: Side panels on desktop become bottom sheets or full-height panels on phones.
entries.motion: Slides with transform in 300 ms with an ease-out curve; follows the finger on touch.
accessibility: Same focus rules as a dialog.
The trigger exposes aria-expanded.

entries.name: Section container
entries.purpose: Gives each block of a page the same width, gutters and vertical rhythm.
useWhen: Every top-level block of a page.
entries.responsive: Gutters 16, 24 and 32 px by range; vertical padding steps from 48 to 96 px; the container is capped, the gutters grow.
entries.motion: The header and the content reveal once when 20% of the section enters the viewport.
accessibility: A <section> with a heading, or aria-labelledby.
One h2 per section.

entries.name: Background pattern
entries.purpose: Decorates a band or a card with a quiet, token-colored pattern.
avoidWhen: More than one pattern in the same viewport.
entries.responsive: Pattern scale stays constant; masks fade the edges so content keeps contrast at every width.
entries.motion: Animated variants loop slowly (20 s or more), pause off screen and stop under reduced motion.
accessibility: Decorative: aria-hidden.
Text over the pattern keeps 4.5:1 measured on the lightest and darkest point.

entries.name: Reveal on scroll
entries.purpose: Brings a block into view once when it enters the viewport.
useWhen: Section headers, grids and media below the fold.
avoidWhen: Content above the fold on first paint.
Text the person is reading while it moves.
entries.responsive: Same effect on every width; travel distance shrinks on phones.
entries.motion: Opacity and translate of 16 px in 500 ms with ease-out, once; stagger of 60 ms.
accessibility: Content is visible with scripting off.
Under reduced motion everything is visible at once.

entries.name: Animated counter
entries.purpose: Counts a number up to its value when it appears or changes.
useWhen: Real metrics in a stats band.
Values that update in a dashboard.
avoidWhen: Numbers the person needs to read immediately on every visit.
entries.responsive: Tabular numbers keep the width stable.
entries.motion: Counts in 600 to 1200 ms with ease-out; on change, only the digits that differ roll.
accessibility: The final value is in the markup; the animation is presentation.
Live updates use aria-live polite sparingly.

entries.name: Theme toggle
entries.purpose: Switches between light, dark and system themes.
useWhen: Sites and systems with a dark theme.
entries.responsive: Lives in the header on desktop and in the mobile menu on phones.
entries.motion: The icon cross-fades and rotates 90 degrees in 200 ms; the page does not flash.
accessibility: The button name says the action, not the current state.
The choice persists and respects prefers-color-scheme by default.

entries.name: Site header
entries.purpose: Identifies the site and gives the main routes and the primary action.
entries.responsive: Links collapse into a drawer below 1024 px; the primary action stays visible down to 390 px.
entries.motion: Background, border and height transition in 200 ms after 8 px of scroll; hides on scroll down and returns on scroll up when sticky.
accessibility: <header> with a <nav aria-label>.
A skip link is the first focusable element.
Current page marked with aria-current.

entries.name: Mobile navigation
entries.purpose: Shows the site routes on small screens.
useWhen: Whenever the header links do not fit.
entries.responsive: Covers the viewport on phones; links are 48 px tall.
entries.motion: Panel slides or fades in 250 ms; links stagger 30 ms.
accessibility: Focus trap, Escape and return of focus.
The page behind is inert.

entries.name: Mega menu
entries.purpose: Opens a wide panel with grouped destinations under a header item.
useWhen: Sites with many products or sections that need descriptions.
entries.responsive: Becomes accordion groups inside the mobile navigation.
entries.motion: The panel fades and moves 8 px in 200 ms; moving between triggers resizes the same panel with a layout animation.
accessibility: Opens on click and on Enter, not only hover.
Escape closes and returns focus.

entries.name: Announcement bar
entries.purpose: Carries one short, dated message above the header.
useWhen: A launch, an event or a deadline.
entries.responsive: One line; the text truncates before the link does.
entries.motion: Slides down once on entry; a long message scrolls as a marquee that pauses on hover and focus.
accessibility: Not a live region.
Dismiss button with a name.

entries.name: Breadcrumbs
entries.purpose: Shows where the page sits in the hierarchy.
useWhen: Pages two or more levels deep.
entries.responsive: Middle levels collapse into a menu on phones; the parent link stays.
entries.motion: None beyond the link hover.
accessibility: <nav aria-label> with an ordered list.
Current page has aria-current=page.

entries.name: Site footer
entries.purpose: Closes the page with the secondary routes, legal links and contact.
entries.responsive: Columns become a two-column grid on tablets and accordions or a single list on phones.
entries.motion: Reveals with the last section; link hovers only.
accessibility: <footer> with labeled <nav> groups.
Link text contrast of 4.5:1 on the footer background.

entries.name: Split hero
entries.purpose: Opens the page with the promise on one side and proof of the product on the other.
useWhen: Product, portal and tool pages with a real screenshot, panel or demo.
entries.responsive: Stacks with the text first; the visual keeps its aspect ratio and loses decorative layers.
entries.motion: Text enters in a short stagger; the visual fades and rises 16 px; inside the visual, one slow loop or a sequence of real states.
accessibility: One h1.
The visual has alt text or is marked decorative when the text says the same.

entries.name: Centered hero
entries.purpose: Opens the page with one statement and one action in the middle of the screen.
useWhen: Landing pages with a single idea.
avoidWhen: Long headlines that wrap to four lines.
anatomy: supporting visual or pattern below or behind
variants: with media below the fold line
entries.responsive: Headline scales with clamp(); actions stack full width below 480 px.
entries.motion: Headline reveals by line or word once; the background pattern moves slowly.
accessibility: One h1.
Headline, sentence and primary action visible at 1280 x 800 without scrolling.

entries.name: Media hero
entries.purpose: Opens the page on a photograph or a video with the text over it.
avoidWhen: Text that loses contrast over the image.
entries.responsive: Art direction per range (different crop on phones); video is replaced by the poster on phones and under data saver.
entries.motion: Slow scale of the image (1 to 1.05 in 12 s) or the video itself; text fades in.
accessibility: Video has no sound and can be paused.
Contrast measured over the scrim.

entries.name: Feature grid
entries.purpose: Presents three to six capabilities with equal weight.
useWhen: Capabilities that are parallel and short.
avoidWhen: One capability is far more important: use a feature split or bento.
anatomy: item: icon or small visual, title, two-line description, link (optional)
entries.responsive: Three columns, then two, then one; the icon moves beside the title on phones.
entries.motion: Items reveal in a stagger; the icon or the border reacts on hover.
accessibility: Items are a list.
Icons are decorative.

entries.name: Bento grid
entries.purpose: Shows capabilities in tiles of different sizes, each with its own small visual.
useWhen: Four to seven capabilities with unequal weight and a real visual each.
entries.responsive: Tiles fall into one column in reading order on phones; tall tiles take a fixed aspect ratio.
entries.motion: Each tile has one small loop or a hover interaction tied to what it shows; tiles reveal in a stagger.
accessibility: Reading order equals DOM order.
Tile visuals have text alternatives when they carry information.

entries.name: Feature split
entries.purpose: Explains one capability with text beside a large visual.
useWhen: A capability that needs a paragraph and a screenshot.
entries.responsive: Stacks with the text first.
entries.motion: The visual reveals with a mask or rises; the sticky variant swaps visuals as the text scrolls.
accessibility: Visual has alt text.

entries.name: Steps
entries.purpose: Shows a process in a small number of ordered steps.
variants: with code or screenshot per step
entries.responsive: Horizontal becomes vertical below 768 px.
entries.motion: The connector draws as the section scrolls; each step lights up in turn.
accessibility: Ordered list.
Numbers are text.

entries.name: Stats band
entries.purpose: States a few real numbers in large type.
entries.responsive: Two columns on phones.
entries.motion: Values count up once when visible.
accessibility: Value and label are read together (definition list).

entries.name: Logo strip
entries.purpose: Shows the logos of real customers, partners or tools.
entries.responsive: Wraps to two rows or scrolls as a marquee.
entries.motion: Marquee at constant speed, pausing on hover and focus; static under reduced motion.
accessibility: Each logo has the company name as alt text.

entries.name: Marquee
entries.purpose: Scrolls a row of short items continuously.
avoidWhen: Text that must be read whole.
More than two marquees on a page.
entries.responsive: Speed in pixels per second stays constant across widths.
entries.motion: Linear translate loop; pauses on hover, focus and when off screen.
accessibility: The duplicate group is aria-hidden.
A pause control exists when the content is meaningful.

entries.name: Testimonial
entries.purpose: Quotes a real person about the product.
useWhen: Real quotes with name and role.
entries.responsive: Grid becomes a single column or a swipe carousel.
entries.motion: Reveal on scroll; the carousel moves on demand, not by itself.
accessibility: blockquote with a cite or figcaption.
Carousel controls have names.

entries.name: Pricing table
entries.purpose: Lets the person compare plans and choose one.
anatomy: plan card: name, price, period, description, feature list, action
entries.responsive: Cards stack with the recommended plan first; the comparison table becomes one plan per tab.
entries.motion: The price rolls when the period changes; the highlighted card has a quiet moving border or glow.
accessibility: The switch is a radio group or a toggle with a name.
Included and excluded features have text, not only icons.

entries.name: Comparison table
entries.purpose: Compares options feature by feature.
useWhen: Plans or products with many attributes.
entries.responsive: Below 768 px shows one option at a time with a switcher, or scrolls inside its own container with the first column fixed.
entries.motion: Row hover highlight; the sticky header gains a shadow.
accessibility: Real <table> with th scope.
Marks have text alternatives.

entries.name: FAQ
entries.purpose: Answers the questions that stop a person from acting.
useWhen: Real questions from sales and support.
variants: two columns with intro on the left
entries.responsive: Single column on phones.
entries.motion: Accordion open and close.
accessibility: Accordion rules.
FAQPage structured data when the content qualifies.

entries.name: Call to action band
entries.purpose: Repeats the primary action after the page made its case.
useWhen: End of a page or of a long section.
entries.responsive: Action goes full width on phones.
entries.motion: Background pattern or gradient moves slowly; the band reveals on scroll.
accessibility: Heading level follows the outline.
Contrast measured over the background.

entries.name: Inline signup form
entries.purpose: Collects an email address in one field and one button.
entries.responsive: Input and button stack below 480 px.
entries.motion: The button shows progress; success replaces the form with a check that draws in 300 ms.
accessibility: Visible or screen-reader label.
Errors linked with aria-describedby and announced.
autocomplete=email.

entries.name: Article header
entries.purpose: Introduces an article with title, context and authorship.
entries.responsive: Meta wraps below the lead; the cover goes full width.
entries.motion: Title and lead fade in; the cover reveals with a soft scale.
accessibility: h1 for the title.
Dates in <time datetime>.

entries.name: Prose
entries.purpose: Sets long-form text with a comfortable measure and rhythm.
entries.responsive: Measure of 60 to 75 characters; wide elements (tables, code) scroll inside their own box; type steps down one size on phones.
entries.motion: None in the text; anchors scroll smoothly and flash the target heading.
accessibility: Heading levels do not skip.
Links are distinguishable without color.
Line height of at least 1.5.

entries.name: Table of contents
entries.purpose: Lists the headings of the page and shows the current one.
useWhen: Articles and docs with four or more sections.
entries.responsive: Side rail from 1280 px; collapsible block below.
entries.motion: The active marker slides to the current heading as the page scrolls.
accessibility: <nav aria-label>.
aria-current on the active link.

entries.name: Reading progress
entries.purpose: Shows how far the person is in a long text.
entries.responsive: Same on every width.
entries.motion: Scale on the X axis driven by scroll position (scroll timeline where supported).
accessibility: Decorative: aria-hidden.

entries.name: Post card
entries.purpose: Summarizes an article in a list.
useWhen: Blog index, related posts, home highlights.
entries.responsive: Horizontal cards become vertical below 640 px.
entries.motion: The cover scales to 1.03 inside its frame and the title underlines on hover.
accessibility: One link per card with the title as its name.
Cover alt empty when the title says the same.

entries.name: Post list
entries.purpose: Lays out the posts of a blog or a category.
useWhen: Blog index, tag and category pages.
anatomy: grid or list of post cards
entries.responsive: Three, two, then one column.
entries.motion: Cards reveal in a stagger as they enter.
accessibility: Filters are links to real pages.
The list is a list.

entries.name: Author box
entries.purpose: Says who wrote the content.
useWhen: End of an article, author pages.
entries.responsive: Avatar above the text on phones.
entries.motion: Reveal on scroll.
accessibility: Name is a heading or strong text; links have names.

entries.name: Callout
entries.purpose: Sets a note, tip or warning apart from the running text.
useWhen: Information the reader should not miss.
avoidWhen: More than one per screen of text.
entries.responsive: Full width of the measure.
entries.motion: None.
accessibility: The type is in the text or title, not only in color.
role=note.

entries.name: Code block
entries.purpose: Shows code with highlighting and a copy button.
useWhen: Commands and source code in articles and docs.
variants: tabs by language or package manager
entries.responsive: Scrolls horizontally inside its box; never wraps commands.
entries.motion: The copy button swaps to a check for 1.5 s.
accessibility: Copy button with a name and a polite confirmation.
Contrast of the theme checked in both modes.

entries.name: Figure
entries.purpose: Places an image, diagram or table with its caption.
entries.responsive: Wide variants return to the measure on phones; images are responsive with width, height and sizes.
entries.motion: Fades in when loaded; the zoom opens with a shared-element transition.
accessibility: Alt text describes the content; the caption adds context.
Dimensions set to avoid layout shift.

entries.name: Video embed
entries.purpose: Plays a hosted video without loading the player until the person asks.
useWhen: YouTube, Vimeo or self-hosted video in a page.
entries.responsive: Fixed 16:9 (or declared) aspect ratio at every width.
entries.motion: The play button scales on hover; the poster cross-fades to the player.
accessibility: The facade is a button named with the video title.
Captions available; no autoplay with sound.

entries.name: Pull quote
entries.purpose: Lifts one sentence of the text in large type.
entries.responsive: Stays inside the measure on phones.
entries.motion: Reveal on scroll.
accessibility: Marked so screen readers do not read the sentence twice (aria-hidden when it repeats the text).

entries.name: Pagination
entries.purpose: Moves between pages of a list.
entries.responsive: Numbers reduce to previous, current of total and next on phones.
entries.motion: None beyond hover; the list fades while loading.
accessibility: <nav aria-label>.
aria-current on the current page.
Real links on sites.

entries.name: App shell
entries.purpose: Frames every screen of a system with navigation, context and content area.
entries.responsive: The sidebar becomes a drawer below 1024 px; the main area keeps 16 px gutters on phones.
entries.motion: The sidebar width animates with transform or grid columns in 200 ms; route changes cross-fade the main area in 150 ms.
accessibility: Landmarks: nav, header, main.
Skip link to main.
Focus moves to the page heading on route change.

entries.name: Sidebar navigation
entries.purpose: Lists the areas of the system.
useWhen: Systems with five or more areas.
entries.responsive: Drawer on phones and tablets.
entries.motion: The active marker slides between items; groups open with the accordion motion.
accessibility: <nav aria-label>.
aria-current on the active item.
Collapsed items keep their names.

entries.name: Topbar
entries.purpose: Holds global tools: sidebar toggle, breadcrumbs, command trigger, notifications and account.
entries.responsive: Breadcrumbs collapse to the parent; tools move into the account menu on phones.
entries.motion: Gains a border or shadow after the content scrolls.
accessibility: <header> landmark.
Every icon button has a name.

entries.name: Page header
entries.purpose: Names the screen and holds its main actions.
entries.responsive: Actions move below the title; secondary actions collapse into a menu on phones.
entries.motion: None on its own; follows the route transition.
accessibility: The title is the h1 of the screen.
One primary action.

entries.name: Command palette
entries.purpose: Finds screens, records and actions from the keyboard.
useWhen: Systems with many screens or frequent expert users.
entries.responsive: Full-screen sheet on phones.
entries.motion: Opens with the dialog motion; the highlight slides between results.
accessibility: combobox pattern.
The shortcut is shown in the interface and does not override browser shortcuts.

entries.name: Stat card
entries.purpose: Shows one indicator with its change and context.
entries.responsive: Four in a row, then two, then one or a horizontal snap row.
entries.motion: The value counts from the previous number; the change badge fades; the sparkline draws once.
accessibility: Change has a sign and text, not only color or arrow.
Label and value are associated.

entries.name: Chart card
entries.purpose: Presents one chart with its title, period and legend.
useWhen: Trends, comparisons and distributions in a dashboard.
avoidWhen: A chart where one number would do.
entries.responsive: Fixed height per range; fewer axis ticks and a legend below the chart on phones.
entries.motion: Draws once on first load in 600 ms; data changes interpolate; nothing replays on hover.
accessibility: Text summary of the chart.
Series distinguished by more than color.
Data available as a table.

entries.name: Data table
entries.purpose: Lists records in rows with sorting, filtering, selection and row actions.
avoidWhen: Fewer than three columns: use a list.
anatomy: cell types (text, number, badge, date, avatar)
entries.responsive: Below 768 px either turns each row into a card with the key columns, or scrolls inside its box with the first column fixed; never scrolls the page sideways.
entries.motion: Rows fade in on load; sort moves rows with a short layout animation when the set is small; the bulk action bar slides in.
accessibility: Real <table> with th scope and aria-sort.
Row actions reachable by keyboard.
Selection announces the count.
Numbers right-aligned with tabular figures.

entries.name: Filter bar
entries.purpose: Narrows a list by text, attribute and period.
entries.responsive: Filters collapse into a button that opens a drawer; active chips stay visible.
entries.motion: Chips enter and leave with scale and fade in 150 ms; the result count updates with a cross-fade.
accessibility: Every control has a label.
Result count announced politely.
State kept in the URL.

entries.name: Bulk action bar
entries.purpose: Offers actions for the selected rows.
entries.responsive: Fixed at the bottom on phones.
entries.motion: Slides in when the first row is selected and out when the selection clears.
accessibility: Announces the selected count.
Destructive actions confirm.

entries.name: Description list
entries.purpose: Shows the attributes of one record as label and value pairs.
entries.responsive: Label above the value on phones.
entries.motion: Copy confirmation swaps the icon.
accessibility: <dl>, <dt>, <dd>.
Empty values show a dash with a screen-reader text.

entries.name: Activity feed
entries.purpose: Lists what happened to a record or in the system, newest first.
entries.responsive: Single column at every width.
entries.motion: New entries slide in at the top; older entries load on demand.
accessibility: Ordered list with <time> elements.

entries.name: Status indicator
entries.purpose: States the condition of a record or service.
useWhen: Order, payment, deploy and service states.
entries.responsive: Label never hidden.
entries.motion: An in-progress state pulses slowly; a change cross-fades.
accessibility: Text label always present.

entries.name: Form layout
entries.purpose: Organizes fields into sections with one clear submit.
entries.responsive: Single column on phones; the action bar sticks to the bottom.
entries.motion: Sections reveal in order on load; the save button shows progress and then a check; invalid fields shake once, 4 px.
accessibility: One column of fields in reading order.
Error summary focused after a failed submit, with links to the fields.
Leaving with unsaved changes asks first.

entries.name: Form field
entries.purpose: One input with its label, help and error.
entries.responsive: Controls are full width in their column and 44 px tall on touch; font size of 16 px to avoid zoom on iOS.
entries.motion: Border and ring transition in 150 ms; the error message slides down 4 px and fades in.
accessibility: Label linked to the control.
Error linked with aria-describedby and aria-invalid.
autocomplete and inputmode set.

entries.name: Stepper
entries.purpose: Splits a long task into ordered steps.
avoidWhen: Forms that fit on one screen.
entries.responsive: The step list becomes 'step 2 of 4' with a progress bar on phones.
entries.motion: Step content slides in the direction of travel in 250 ms; the progress bar grows.
accessibility: aria-current=step.
Focus moves to the step heading.
Data kept when going back.

entries.name: File upload
entries.purpose: Receives files by drop or by picker and shows their progress.
entries.responsive: The picker button is the main path on touch.
entries.motion: The zone reacts to drag over; progress bars grow; finished files settle into the list.
accessibility: Works with keyboard through the native input.
Progress and errors announced.

entries.name: Toast
entries.purpose: Confirms the result of an action without interrupting.
entries.responsive: Bottom center on phones, above the bottom navigation.
entries.motion: Slides and fades in 200 ms; stacks compress; dismisses after 5 s and pauses on hover.
accessibility: role=status for success, role=alert for errors.
Time enough to read; never the only record of an error.

entries.name: Alert banner
entries.purpose: States a condition of the page or system that stays until resolved.
useWhen: Validation summary, degraded service, pending action.
entries.responsive: Full width of its container.
entries.motion: Expands into place without pushing content abruptly.
accessibility: role=alert only when it appears in response to an action.
Type in text.

entries.name: Confirm dialog
entries.purpose: Asks before an action that cannot be undone.
anatomy: title naming the action and the object
entries.responsive: Bottom sheet on phones.
entries.motion: Dialog motion.
accessibility: Focus starts on cancel.
The confirm button repeats the verb.

entries.name: Empty state
entries.purpose: Explains why there is nothing here and what to do next.
useWhen: First use, no results, cleared lists.
entries.responsive: Centered in the region, never in the whole viewport when the region is a card.
entries.motion: The illustration has one quiet loop; the block fades in.
accessibility: Text says the cause and the next step.

entries.name: Error state
entries.purpose: Says what failed and offers the way out.
entries.responsive: Same structure at every width.
entries.motion: Fades in; retry shows progress.
accessibility: role=alert when it replaces content after an action.
No blame, no jargon.

entries.name: Skeleton
entries.purpose: Holds the shape of content while it loads.
avoidWhen: Spinners in the middle of a layout that could keep its shape.
anatomy: blocks with the size of the real content
entries.responsive: Follows the layout of each range.
entries.motion: A slow shimmer or pulse; static under reduced motion.
accessibility: The region sets aria-busy.
Skeletons are hidden from screen readers.

entries.name: Progress
entries.purpose: Shows how much of a task is done.
entries.responsive: Full width of its container.
entries.motion: The indicator grows with a 300 ms transition on transform.
accessibility: role=progressbar with value and name.

entries.name: Settings layout
entries.purpose: Organizes configuration into areas with a stable navigation.
entries.responsive: The navigation becomes a select or a list page that drills in on phones.
entries.motion: Area change cross-fades the content.
